name: Police
overview: Scripture calls believers to courage and strength, trusting in God's presence as they face challenges (Joshua 1:9). It emphasizes the importance of justice, urging the defense of the vulnerable such as the poor, fatherless, and widows, and the relief of the oppressed (Psalms 82:3; Isaiah 1:17). Righteousness is portrayed as bold and confident, contrasting with the fearfulness of the wicked (Proverbs 28:1), and there is joy in administering just judgment while condemning workers of iniquity (Proverbs 21:15). Ultimately, God is our refuge and strength, a present help in trouble, supporting those who uphold justice (Psalms 46:1).
